blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) aims to translate medical images into diagnostic text, reducing radiologists' workload and standardizing clinical documentation. Nonetheless, existing approaches mainly focus on single-timepoint analysis and fail to capture temporal disease evolution across longitudinal examinations. While recent longitudinal RRG (LRRG) approaches incorporate historical data, they often combine images from different time points within a single representation space, leading to blurred semantics and inconsistent temporal reasoning. In this work, we propose a Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model (TIM), a two-stage framework that explicitly decouples spatial pathology from temporal progression and iteratively refines reports through mutual feedback. Stage I performs temporal-decoupled representation learning, separating temporal evolution patterns from disease-specific features and generating radiology reports for both prior and current studies. Stage II introduces a mutual report refinement mechanism that identifies diagnostic inconsistencies within prior reports and iteratively rectifies both prior and current reports through error-sensitive feedback. Experiments on the Longitudinal-MIMIC dataset demonstrate that TIM surpasses existing single-image and longitudinal baselines, achieving new state-of-the-art performance across both language and clinical metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/yihengd/TIM.
blocks.zh: 自动放射学报告生成(RRG)旨在将医疗图像转化为诊断文本,减少放射学家的工作量并规范临床文献. 尽管如此,现有办法主要侧重于单一时间点分析,未能掌握纵向检查中的时间性疾病的演变情况。 虽然最近的纵向RRG(LRRG)方法吸收了历史数据,但它们往往把不同时点的图像合并在一个单一的表示空间内,导致语义模糊和时间推理不一致. 在这项工作中,我们提议采用 " 暂时性脱钩 " 模式(TIM),这是明确将空间病理与时间发展脱钩的两阶段框架,并通过相互反馈对报告进行反复完善。 阶段 我进行时间分解的表述学习,将时间演变模式与疾病特征区分开来,并为以往和目前的研究编写放射学报告。 第二阶段采用了一种相互报告完善机制,确定以前报告中的诊断不一致之处,并通过对错误敏感的反馈,反复更正以前和现在的报告。 关于纵向-MIMIC数据集的实验表明,TIM超过了现有的单相和纵向基线,实现了跨语言和临床指标的最新业绩。 代码见https://github.com/yihengd/TIM.

blocks.en: Radiology report generation (RRG) aims to automatically produce diagnostic descriptions from medical images, offering great potential to alleviate radiologists’ workload and standardize clinical documentation. By converting images into structured diagnostic narratives, RRG systems can assist physicians in drafting reports, standardize terminology usage, and reduce human variability [ 20 , 23 ] .
blocks.zh: 放射科报告生成(RRG)旨在从医疗图像中自动生成诊断描述,为减轻放射科医生的工作量和使临床文献标准化提供了巨大潜力。 通过将图像转换成结构化的诊断性叙事,RRG系统可以帮助医生起草报告,使术语的使用标准化,并减少人类的变异性[20,23].

blocks.en: Recent advances in vision-language models [ 18 , 22 , 27 , 44 ] have enabled significant progress in RRG, achieving accurate report generation for chest X-rays [ 8 , 7 , 5 , 19 , 50 , 46 , 37 , 15 ] . Despite these advances, most existing approaches focus solely on single-timepoint studies, overlooking the temporal continuity that is intrinsic to real clinical workflows [ 45 ] . In practice, radiologists routinely compare the current study with prior examinations to assess disease progression, treatment response, and emergence of new abnormalities [ 11 ] . Without modeling temporal evolution, single-timepoint methods struggle to capture longitudinal progression and generate reports that are temporally inconsistent or misaligned with the patient’s actual disease trajectory.
blocks.zh: 近期在视觉语言模型[18、22、27、44]方面的进步使RRG取得重大进展,实现了胸部X射线的准确报告生成[8、7、5、19、50、46、37、15]。 尽管取得了这些进步,但大多数现有方法只注重单时点研究,忽略了真实临床工作流程所固有的时间连续性[45]. 在实践中,放射学家经常将目前的研究与以前的检查进行比较,以评估疾病进展、治疗反应和新的异常现象的出现[11]。 如果不模拟时间演变,单时点方法就难以捕捉纵向进展,并生成与患者实际疾病轨迹不同步或错配的报告。

blocks.en:
To address these limitations, several recent studies [ 55 , 45 , 34 , 28 , 29 , 54 , 53 ] have explored longitudinal radiology report generation (LRRG).
These approaches incorporate historical images and reports to produce reports encompassing both current findings and disease progression.
While these advancements mark a significant step forward, they overlook a fundamental property of the LRRG task: the heterogeneity between pathological recognition and progression modeling.
Pathological recognition is concerned with the spatial localization [ 25 ] of disease-specific patterns within a single study (e.g., pulmonary opacity), whereas progression modeling captures temporal changes across studies (e.g., interval increase or improvement).
As shown in Fig. 1 (a), existing methods conflate these two distinct subtasks within a single representation learning network, resulting in the blend of static disease cues and temporal evolution features.
This entanglement obscures their unique semantics and limits the model’s capacity for accurate temporal reasoning.
blocks.zh:
为了消除这些局限性,最近的一些研究[55、45、34、28、29、54、53]探讨了纵向放射学报告的生成。
这些方法包括了历史图像和报告,以产生包括当前调查结果和疾病进展的报告。
虽然这些进步标志着向前迈出了一大步,但它们忽略了LRRG任务的基本属性:病理识别与进步模型的异质性.
病理识别与单一研究(如肺不透明)中特定疾病模式的空间局部化[25]有关,而进展模型则捕捉不同研究的时间变化(如间隔增加或改进)。
如图1(a)所示,现有方法将这两个不同的子任务整合在一个单一的表达学习网络内,导致静态疾病提示和时间演化特征的结合。
这种纠缠模糊了他们独特的语义,限制了模型准确的时间推理能力.

blocks.en:
In addition, existing LRRG methods treat report generation as a single-pass procedure, disregarding the mutual dependencies between prior and current reports.
By treating each report as an independent target, these methods fail to leverage the bidirectional cues across time points.
Consequently, they ignore two critical opportunities for enhancing diagnostic reasoning: first, identifying errors in the prior generated report can offer corrective guidance for the current report; second, refining the current report can reveal omissions or misinterpretations in the prior one.
Without mutual refinement, such models often repeat mistakes across visits and fail to characterize disease evolution.
blocks.zh:
此外,现有的 LRRG 方法将报告的生成视为一种单程程序,而忽略了以前和现在的报告之间的相互依赖性。
通过将每份报告作为一个独立的目标,这些方法无法利用跨时间点的双向提示。
因此,它们忽略了加强诊断推理的两个重要机会:第一,查明先前产生的报告中的错误可以为本报告提供纠正性指导;第二,改进当前报告可以发现前一报告中的遗漏或误解。
如果不相互完善,这种模式往往在访问中重复错误,无法描述疾病的演变。

blocks.en:
In this study, we propose Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model (TIM), a two-stage framework for longitudinal radiology report generation.
Stage I performs temporal-decoupled representation learning, wherein a static pathological recognition branch and a dynamic progression modeling branch independently encode disease-specific visual features and cross-visit progression representations, mitigating feature interference between spatial and temporal cues.
Based on these representations, an LLM generates radiology reports for both prior and current examinations.
Stage II introduces mutual report refinement, whereby the prior and current reports serve as reciprocal references to guide the iterative refinement process. Through improved clinical accuracy and temporal coherence, this stage ultimately improves the overall quality and reliability of longitudinal radiology reporting.
blocks.zh:
在这项研究中,我们提议与 " 纵向相互调整模型 " (TIM)暂时脱钩,这是纵向放射学报告生成的两阶段框架。
第一阶段进行时间分解的表达学习,其中静态病理识别分支和动态演进模型分支独立编码疾病特定视觉特征和交叉访问演进表达,缓解空间和时间提示之间的特征干扰.
根据这些表述,LLM为以前和目前的检查生成放射学报告。
第二阶段引入了相互报告完善,以前和目前的报告作为相互参考,指导迭代完善进程。 通过提高临床准确性和时间一致性,这一阶段最终提高了纵向放射学报告的整体质量和可靠性.

blocks.en: Our key contributions are summarized as follows: 1. We introduce TIM, a Temporal-Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement model that adopts a “divide-and-conquer” strategy to exploit the temporal evolution in longitudinal radiology reports. 2. We propose a temporal-decoupled representation learning strategy that separates static pathology from dynamic progression, and employs a dual-timepoint report generation mechanism to capture longitudinal disease semantics while maintaining longitudinal consistency. 3. We design a mutual report refinement module, wherein both prior and current reports are iteratively refined through mutual referencing, effectively reducing temporal error propagation. 4. Experiments on the Longitudinal-MIMIC dataset demonstrate that TIM outperforms both single-image and longitudinal baselines across natural language generation and clinical efficiency metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 1. 我们引入了TIM,一种采用 " 分裂和征服 " 战略的过渡性相互调整模式,利用纵向放射学报告的时间演变。 2. 我们建议采用一个时间分明的表述学习战略,将静态病理与动态进展区分开来,并采用双时点报告生成机制,以捕捉纵向疾病语义,同时保持纵向一致性。 3. 我们设计了一个相互报告完善模块,通过相互参照,反复改进以前和目前的报告,有效减少时间误差传播。 4. 关于纵向-MIMIC数据集的实验表明,TIM在自然语言生成和临床效率衡量标准方面都超过了单一图像和纵向基线。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Radiology Report Generation. RRG aims to automatically produce diagnostic reports from medical images such as chest X-rays. While this task shares similarities with image captioning [ 44 , 51 , 18 ] , it is inherently more complex due to the need for precise clinical terminology and long-form structured descriptions. Early methods generally adopted an encoder-decoder framework [ 1 , 9 , 35 , 44 , 51 ] , where convolutional or transformer-based encoders extract image features and recurrent or transformer-based decoders generate textual reports. To enhance the clinical relevance of generated reports, several works [ 41 , 48 , 26 , 15 , 19 , 5 , 13 ] incorporated domain knowledge or multimodal alignment strategies. Despite these advances, most prior works focus on single-image settings, overlooking the temporal evolution of disease progression across multiple visits.
blocks.zh: 放射科报告生成. RRG旨在从胸部X射线等医疗图像中自动生成诊断报告. 虽然这项任务与图像标题[44,51,18]有相似之处,但由于需要精确的临床术语和长式结构描述,它本质上更为复杂. 早期的方法一般采用编码器-解码器框架[1,9,35,44,51],其中转录器或变压器基编码器提取图像特性,复发或变压器基解码器生成文字报告. 为提高所生成报告的临床相关性,一些工作[41、48、26、15、19、5、13]纳入了域知识或多式联运统一战略。 尽管取得了这些进步,以前大多数作品都侧重于单像环境,忽略了疾病在多次访问中的时间演变。

blocks.en: Longitudinal Radiology Report Generation. LRRG extends traditional RRG to multi-visit scenarios, enabling the capture of disease progression and treatment response. Unlike conventional RRG models that describe only static findings, LRRG aims to model both current pathologies and longitudinal evolutions. Recent methods such as CXRMate [ 34 ] , Prefilling [ 55 ] , HERGen [ 45 ] , HC-LLM [ 29 ] , and Diff-RRG [ 54 ] incorporate temporal or historical information to enhance contextual understanding. However, these approaches often mix static and temporal representations, limiting feature disentanglement. In contrast, our method employs a decoupled representation learning strategy to separate static and dynamic visual cues, enabling the model to capture both stable and evolving abnormalities for more accurate and coherent report generation.
blocks.zh: 纵向放射学报告生成. LRRG将传统的RRG扩展至多访场景,从而能够捕捉疾病进展和治疗反应. 与仅描述静态发现的常规RRG模型不同,LRRG旨在同时模拟目前的病理和纵向演化. 最近的方法如CXRMate [34],预补 [55],HERGen [45],HC-LLM [29],Diff-RRG [54] 都包含了时间或历史信息,以增强背景理解. 然而,这些方法往往混合了静态和时态表述,限制了特征的分离。 与此相反,我们的方法采用了一种脱钩的代表学习战略,将静态和动态的视觉提示分开,使模型能够捕捉到稳定和不断演变的异常情况,从而更准确和连贯地生成报告。

blocks.en:
Self-Refinement Report Generation. Self-refinement has emerged as an effective strategy for improving generative models through iterative revision of outputs based on feedback [ 31 , 49 ] , enhancing factual accuracy and linguistic coherence in natural language generation tasks [ 32 , 21 ] .
However, existing self-refinement methods for report generation [ 37 ] often fail to provide explicit and clinically meaningful feedback, resulting in limited guidance and marginal gains in clinical accuracy.
In contrast, we introduce a dual-timepoint, iterative mutual-refinement approach that goes beyond previous self-refinement by explicitly identifying errors in reports, enabling targeted correction, and substantially improving the clinical accuracy of the final output.
blocks.zh:
自译自审报告生成. 自我完善已经成为一种有效的战略,通过基于反馈[31,49]的迭代修订产出来改进基因模型,提高自然语言生成任务的事实准确性和语言一致性[32,21].
然而,报告生成的现有自我精炼方法[37]往往不能提供明确和临床上有意义的反馈,导致指导有限,临床准确度的提高微乎其微.
相反,我们采用了双时点、迭代的相互精炼方法,它超越了以前的自我精炼,明确识别报告中的错误,能够有针对性地进行校正,并大大提高最终产出的临床准确性。

blocks.en: The overall framework is shown as Fig. 2 . Our proposed TIM comprised two stages: (I) Temporal-Decoupled Representation Learning and (II) Mutual Report Refinement . In Stage I, to mitigate feature interference and enhance the specificity for disease-aware findings and temporal evolution, TIM decouples visual representations into pathological recognition and progression modeling branches, and performs report generation for two timepoints. Stage II further enhances clinical accuracy by introducing Mutual Report Refinement . Through multiple rounds of mutual refinement, TIM suppresses mistakes progressively and yields clinically faithful radiology reports.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Dynamic Progression Modeling

blocks.en: This branch focuses on capturing temporal evolution between consecutive examinations by exploiting the intrinsic spatiotemporal learning capability of the video encoder. We introduce a set of learnable, randomly initialized perception frames { Q 1 , Q 2 } \{Q^{1},Q^{2}\} that share the spatial resolution of chest images { I p , I c } \{I^{p},I^{c}\} and are independently parameterized. The number of perception frames is set to 2 based on experiments in Sec. 4.6 . These frames are inserted between the prior and current images to form a short video sequence, which is then processed by a video encoder E v ​ i ​ d ​ ( ⋅ ) E_{vid}(\cdot) : ( _ , H 1 , H 2 , _ ) = E v ​ i ​ d ​ ( [ I p ; Q 1 ; Q 2 ; I c ] ) , (\_,H^{1},H^{2},\_)=E_{vid}([I^{p};Q^{1};Q^{2};I^{c}]), (3) where [ ⋅ ; ⋅ ] [\cdot;\cdot] denotes concatenation operation. The resulting features { H 1 , H 2 } \{H^{1},H^{2}\} are adaptively fused by a gating module: H g = α ⊙ H 1 + ( 1 − α ) ⊙ H 2 , α = σ ⁡ ( W g ​ [ H 1 ; H 2 ] ) , H_{g}=\alpha\odot H^{1}+(1-\alpha)\odot H^{2},\quad\alpha=\sigma(W_{g}[H^{1};H^{2}]), (4) where ⊙ \odot denotes element-wise multiplication, σ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \sigma(\cdot) is the sigmoid function, and W g W_{g} is a learnable weight matrix. H g H_{g} is then projected into the language space by a linear head W v ​ i ​ d W_{vid} , resulting in a progression feature 𝐟 p ​ r ​ o = W v ​ i ​ d ​ H g \mathbf{f}_{pro}=W_{vid}H_{g} .

To ensure that the learned representations reflect clinically meaningful progressions, we align 𝐟 p ​ r ​ o \mathbf{f}_{pro} with text embeddings 𝐟 t , p ​ r ​ o = E t ​ x ​ t ​ ( 𝒯 p ​ r ​ o ) \mathbf{f}_{t,pro}=E_{txt}(\mathcal{T}_{pro}) derived from progression-related report sentences 𝒯 p ​ r ​ o \mathcal{T}_{pro} : ℒ d ​ p ​ m = − log ⁡ exp ⁡ ( s ​ i ​ m ​ ( 𝐟 p ​ r ​ o , 𝐟 t , p ​ r ​ o ) / τ ) ∑ j exp ⁡ ( s ​ i ​ m ​ ( 𝐟 p ​ r ​ o , 𝐟 t , p ​ r ​ o j ) / τ ) , \mathcal{L}_{dpm}=-\log\frac{\exp(sim(\mathbf{f}_{pro},\mathbf{f}_{t,pro})/\tau)}{\sum_{j}\exp(sim(\mathbf{f}_{pro},\mathbf{f}_{t,pro}^{j})/\tau)}, (5) where ℒ d ​ p ​ m \mathcal{L}_{dpm} denotes the loss of dynamic progression modeling branch. This alignment encourages the model to focus on true pathological evolution rather than irrelevant imaging variations such as positioning changes.

blocks.en: Although Stage I carries out a detailed feature modeling process, the generated reports may still contain inaccurate or inconsistent disease descriptions, particularly for subtle abnormalities. We further observe that about 70% of such errors in prior reports reappear in the current one owing to the temporal consistency across visits. Stage II introduces a mutual refinement mechanism to reduce this issue. It identifies these errors by comparing the generated prior report with its ground truth, and uses them as refinement guidance for a second-round report generation. To clarify notation, throughout this stage, we use the superscript ( j ) (j) to denote the variable obtained after the j t ​ h j^{th} refinement iteration.

blocks.en:
Longitudinal MIMIC-CXR. Experiments are conducted on the Longitudinal-MIMIC dataset [ 55 ] derived from the MIMIC-CXR [ 20 ] , a large-scale dataset of de-identified chest radiographs paired with corresponding reports.
Longitudinal-MIMIC organizes multiple visits per patient, with each sample comprising a tuple of {previous image, previous report, current image, current report}.
Following the official split of MIMIC-CXR, this dataset includes 26,156 patients and 92,374 samples for training, 203 patients and 737 samples for validation, and 266 patients and 2,058 samples for testing.
We used Qwen3-plus [ 52 ] to extract progression descriptions from reports, which are employed in dynamic progression modeling in Sec 3.2.2 .

纵向-MIMIC组织每个病人的多次出诊,每个样本包括一个{上一个图像、前一个报告、当前图像、当前报告}的翻转。
MIMIC-CXR正式分拆后,本数据集包括26,156名患者和92,374个培训样本,203名患者和737个验证样本,266名患者和2,058个测试样本.

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics. We evaluated the performances of our model using natural language generation (NLG) metrics and clinical efficacy (CE) metrics. For NLG evaluation, we employed BLEU-n [ 36 ] , ROUGE-L [ 24 ] , and METEOR [ 2 ] . blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison with State-of-the-art Methods
blocks.zh: 4.3 与最新技术的比较 方法

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , we compare our model with several recent approaches. Our framework achieves new state-of-the-art performance across all evaluation metrics, outperforming both single-input and longitudinal-input methods. Specifically, compared with single-image models, our method improves by 0.018 on BLEU-4, and 0.030 on ROUGE-L over RADAR [ 15 ] , as well as 0.051 on F1-score over GMoD [ 50 ] . Furthermore, relative to longitudinal-input models, our approach further achieves gains of 0.025 on BLEU-1, 0.011 on ROUGE-L, and 0.037 on F1-score over Diff-RRG [ 54 ] , demonstrating that effectively leveraging temporal image sequences together with report information substantially enhances both the linguistic quality and clinical accuracy of generated radiology reports.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,我们把我们的模式与最近的一些办法进行比较。 我们的框架实现了所有评价衡量标准的最新业绩,优于单一投入和纵向投入方法。 具体地说,与单像模型相比,我们的方法在BLEU-4上改进了0.018,在ROUGE-L上改进了0.030,在RADAR上改进了[15],在F1-分数上改进了0.051,在GMOD上改进了[50]。 此外,与纵向输入模型相比,我们的方法在BLEU-1、ROUGE-L和F1-分数上分别取得了0.025和0.037的效益,表明有效利用时间图像序列和报告信息可大大提高生成的放射报告的语言质量和临床准确性。

blocks.en: Starting from the baseline model, which uses only the current images for visual feature extraction and only produces current reports, it shows limited ability to capture longitudinal information and clinical semantics. Adding the DPM branch (model (a)) improves all metrics (e.g., BLEU-1 from 0.396 to 0.414, F1-score from 0.404 to 0.422), demonstrating the importance of temporal feature modeling for understanding disease progression. Incorporating the DRG mechanism (model (b)) boosts BLEU-4 and F1 to 0.114 and 0.446, as dual-time generation encourages temporal coherence. Introducing the disease semantic alignment loss ℒ s ​ p ​ r \mathcal{L}_{spr} (model (c)) enforces consistency between static visual features and disease-aware text, raising F1-score to 0.460. Similarly, the progression alignment loss ℒ d ​ p ​ m \mathcal{L}_{dpm} (model (d)) aligns temporal features with progression descriptions, increasing BLEU-4 to 0.117. Finally, combining all modules (model (e)) achieves the highest overall performance across all metrics. These results confirm that each component contributes synergistically, improving both language quality and clinical accuracy.

blocks.en: Starting from the base model, where LLM receives only the image feature and the generated report from Stage I, the performance remains limited with BLEU-1 of 0.419 and F1-score of 0.483. This indicates that without additional feedback or refinement objectives, the model struggles to correct its own diagnostic biases. When the prior difference input is introduced, the model gains refinement guidance from discrepancies between the generated and the GT prior reports. This addition yields notable improvements, particularly in CE metrics (e.g., precision of 0.551 and F1-score of 0.487), suggesting that feedback from errors can guide the model to recognize and correct misclassified diseases better. Further introducing the ℒ Δ \mathcal{L}_{\Delta} leads to the best overall performance, including BLEU-4 of 0.124 and F1-score of 0.511, confirming its role of ensuring refinement towards semantically meaningful corrections rather than arbitrary rewriting.

blocks.en: Number of Perception Frames. We perform a hyperparameter analysis on the number of perception frames in Stage I, evaluating performance with ROUGE-L and F1-score. Results in Fig. 6 show that with no perception frames, performance drops significantly. Using 1 to 3 frames yields consistently high results, with two frames performing best. 5 or 10 frames degrade performance slightly, likely due to redundant temporal interactions. This indicates that two perception frames provide an optimal balance between temporal reasoning and model stability.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we presented TIM, a novel framework for LRRG task. TIM decouples dynamic progression modeling from static pathological recognition and generates dual-timepoint reports to accurately capture temporal evolution. With mutual refinement, TIM effectively captures disease evolution and significantly mitigates diagnostic bias. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TIM achieves state-of-the-art results across NLG and CE metrics.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出了TIM,这是LRRG任务的新框架. TIM将动态进化模型与静态病理识别脱钩,生成双时点报告以准确捕捉时间演化. 通过相互完善,TIM能有效捕捉疾病进化,显著缓解诊断偏差. 广泛的实验表明,TIM在NLG和CE指标上都取得了最先进的结果。

blocks.en: Beyond report-level metrics, we quantitatively evaluate spatiotemporal consistency by extracting medical condition labels from predicted and ground-truth prior/current reports with CheXbert and deriving progression states (stable, worsening, improving) based on label transitions. As shown in Table. 4 , we observe that incorporating the dynamic progression modeling branch substantially improves progression F1 scores from 0.78 to 0.81, with further gains when dynamic-aware textual supervision and stage II mutual refinement are applied, whose F1-score reaches 0.84, demonstrating more accurate temporal reasoning.

blocks.en: Appendix D Examples of Clinical Descriptions of Medical Conditions
blocks.zh: 附录D 病情临床描述实例

blocks.en: As demonstrated in Section 3.2.1 , to couple pathological features with clinical semantics, we expand each medical condition into a clinical description using external medical knowledge sources such as UMLS and PubMed. Each description summarizes the characteristic radiographic manifestation of the disease on chest radiographs and follows a standardized template in the form of “{ condition } on chest x-ray refers to …” to ensure consistent linguistic structure across disease categories. This formulation preserves key clinical terminology (e.g., opacity, cardiomegaly, air bronchogram) while maintaining concise semantics suitable for vision–language alignment. Table 5 presents representative examples of these disease-aware textual descriptions.
blocks.zh: 如第3.2.1节所示,对于带有临床语义的病理特征,我们利用UMLS和PubMed等外部医学知识来源,将每一种医学条件扩展为临床描述。 每个描述都概括了该病在胸腔放射图上的特征辐射表现,并遵循一个标准模板,其形式是“{状况}在胸腔X射线上指...”,以确保各疾病类别语言结构一致。 这种配方保留了关键的临床术语(如不透明、心肌、空气支气管图),同时保持了适合视觉-语言对齐的简明语义。 表5提供了这些有病意识的文字描述的典型例子。

blocks.en: To further illustrate the effectiveness of our proposed TIM, we present four case studies. Each case compares model outputs from both Stage I and II with the ground truth reports, shows the predicted observations, and reports the ROUGE-L score for each output. The 14 observation categories are { enlarged cardiomediastinum, cardiomegaly, lung opacity, lung lesion, edema, consolidation, pneumonia, atelectasis, pneumothorax, pleural effusion, pleural other, fracture, support devices, no finding } . The label codes 0, 1, 2, and 3 denote { not mentioned, positive, negative, uncertain } .
blocks.zh: 为了进一步说明我们提议的技术性投资的有效性,我们提出了四个案例研究。 每个案例将第一阶段和第二阶段的模型产出与地面真相报告进行比较,显示预测的观测结果,并报告每个产出的ROUGE-L分数。 这14个观测类别是{扩大心肌、心肌、肺部不透明、肺部损伤、水肿、合并、肺炎、肾上腺素、肺栓塞、胸膜充血、胸膜其他、骨折、辅助装置、无发现}。 标签代码0、1、2和3表示{未提及、正、负、不确定}。

blocks.en: As shown in Figs. 9 – 11 , these qualitative evaluations demonstrate how our method captures temporal disease progression and corrects cross-time inconsistencies. In the predicted reports, red and green fonts indicate statements that are consistent with and conflicting with the ground truth, respectively. Blue numbers in the predicted observations mark classification errors.
blocks.zh: 如法果所显. 9 — 11, 这些定性评价证明了我们的方法如何捕捉时间性疾病的发展并纠正跨时间的不一致。 在预测的报告中,红色和绿色字体分别表示符合和与地面真相相冲突的说法. 预测观测中的蓝色数字标记了分类错误.

blocks.en: Case 1 is shown in Fig. 9 . For the prior exam, both the ground truth and Stage I agree that the endotracheal tubes are removed, and no pneumothorax is present. Stage II preserves these correct findings, but also introduces a left chest tube that is not described in the prior ground truth. For the current exam, Stage I incorrectly omits the right IJ catheter described in the ground truth and reports removal of the chest tube, which contradicts the ground truth. Stage II corrects most of these errors for the current study: it restores the presence and stability of the left retrocardiac opacity, explicitly reports bilateral small pleural effusions and mild pulmonary vascular congestion, and states that heart size is mildly enlarged but stable, all consistent with the ground truth.
blocks.zh: 案例1见图9。 对于之前的考试,地面真理和第一阶段都同意去除内分泌管,没有肺炎. 第二阶段保留了这些正确的发现,但也引入了在之前的地面真理中没有描述的左胸管. 对于本次考试,第一阶段错误地省略了地面真相中描述的右侧IJ导管,并报告移除了胸管,这与地面真相相矛盾. 第二阶段为当前研究纠正了大部分这些错误:它恢复了左转心肌不透明的存在和稳定性,明确报告双边小胸膜充血和轻度肺血管堵塞,并声明心脏体积略微膨胀但稳定,均符合地面真理.

blocks.en: Case 2 is shown in Fig. 10 . For the prior examination, Stage I correctly reports increased bilateral pulmonary opacities and cardiomegaly but omitted the newly developed small right pleural effusion described in the ground truth. Stage II recovers the pleural effusion and preserves the finding of unchanged cardiomegaly. For the current examination, Stage I captures worsening bilateral opacities and stable cardiomegaly, but again misses the small right pleural effusion and provides a slightly different endotracheal tube position. After refinement, Stage II restores the small right pleural effusion and retrocardiac air-space opacity reported in the ground truth.
blocks.zh: 案例2如图10所示。 关于前次检查,第一阶段正确地报告,双边肺不透明性和心肌增高,但忽略了新开发的、在地面真相中描述的右侧小排卵法。 第二阶段恢复胸膜充血,保留了心肌无变化的发现. 对于目前的检查来说,第一阶段捕捉到日益恶化的双边不透明性和稳定的心肌,但再次错过了右侧小胸充血,提供了稍有不同的内分泌管位置. 经过完善后,第二阶段恢复了地面真相中报道的微小的右胸充电和回心式空气-空间不透明.

blocks.en: From these cases, we observe that Stage II refinement improves both report completeness and disease-label accuracy compared with Stage I outputs, indicating that the refinement process reduces repeated errors across timepoints and yields reports that align more closely with the ground truth progression.
blocks.zh: 从这些情况来看,我们发现,第二阶段的改进比第一阶段的产出提高了报告的完整性和疾病标签的准确性,表明改进过程减少了跨时间点的重复错误,并产生了与实地真相进展更密切配合的报告。

blocks.en: We also present a representative failure case in which the model does not recover the subtle temporal evolution described in the ground truth reports. As shown in Fig. 11 , the prior ground truth report documents a small right-basilar consolidation, and the current GT report describes a rapid interval decrease of this opacity. However, the visual appearance of this lesion is extremely subtle and often confounded by postoperative changes, vascular markings, and acquisition variability across the two time points. As a result, both Stage I and Stage II tend to produce more conservative normal findings, which is a common behavior observed when the radiographic evidence for a minor abnormality is ambiguous. This example illustrates a challenging scenario driven by imaging subtlety. Future work may incorporate uncertainty modeling to better handle such borderline cases.
blocks.zh: 我们还提出一个具有代表性的失败案例,即模型无法恢复实地真相报告中描述的微妙的时间演变。 如图11所示,先前的地面真相报告记录了一次小的右巴西拉合并,目前的GT报告描述了这种不透明度的迅速缩短。 然而,这种损伤的视觉外观极其微妙,常常被术后变化,血管标记,以及两个时间点的获取变异所困扰. 因此,第一阶段和第二阶段都倾向于产生更保守的正常发现,这是当一个轻微异常的射线学证据模棱两可时观察到的常见行为. 这个例子说明了由影像微妙性驱动的具有挑战性的情景。 今后的工作可能包括建立不确定性模型,以便更好地处理这种边缘案件。
